name: check-workflow
description: Check branch cleanup settings and releases read-only, remove duplicate ForgeSteward workflow rules, safely consolidate root Claude instructions, and configure English collaboration defaults in an existing root entry; submit cleanup as a PR or MR without merging. Release findings are reported only.

interface.shortDescription: Check releases, clean rules, and set English collaboration.
interface.longDescription: Read branch cleanup settings and reconcile releases against the repository contract; report release findings only. Remove duplicate ForgeSteward workflow rules, safely consolidate root Claude instructions, then configure English collaboration defaults in an existing root entry. Preserve other project conventions and submit cleanup as a PR or MR without merging. Settings stay unchanged; explicit check-only requests remain read-only.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $forge-steward-check-workflow to inspect branch cleanup settings and reconcile release evidence read-only, remove duplicate ForgeSteward workflow policy (including legacy blocks), safely consolidate root Claude instructions under the bundled migration rules, then configure English collaboration defaults in an existing root entry under the bundled language rules. Preserve other project conventions and report release findings only. Validate, commit, push, and open a PR or MR for cleanup without merging.
